title: Nordic Seeded Whole-Grain Rye Loaf
summary: A rye, wholemeal and oat batter full of seeds, raised in the tin and baked long and slow.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir all the dough ingredients together with the spatula for 2-3 min to a thick, sticky paste; there is no kneading.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Oil the tin, scrape in the dough, smooth with a wet spatula and press the topping seeds over the surface.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1-1½ h until the dough reaches about 1 cm below the rim. Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 60-70 min, covering with foil after 40 min, until the centre reads 96-98 °C.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Turn out and cool on the rack, then wrap in a cloth and leave overnight before slicing thinly.

tips: Wet the spatula to smooth the sticky dough.
Wait overnight before slicing or it will be gummy.
Slice thinly and top with cheese or avocado.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature for up to 5 days, or freeze in slices. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
